description: Increases 3% Damage Dealt Increases 1% Damage Received (+1% for Ranged Heroes)
Recovers 8% Mana when a Skill or Normal Attack hits an enemy
Gains 10% Cooldown Reduction for Ultimate only (subject to 40% CDR cap)
Increases 16% Crit Chance from equipment Increases 8% Ability Power from equipment
Gains (18 - 60) Armor Pierce and Magic Pierce

Strike 3 consecutive Normal Attacks on an enemy will summon a Holy Spirit: Range: 9.5m Attack Speed: Equals to user's Attack Speed Power: True Damage = Target's 2% MaxHP Duration: 5s (Normal Attacks will replenish the duration)
Next Normal Attack / Skill on enemy will deal additionally ((80 + (Lv*8)(30% AP)) Magic Damage Use Normal Attack / Skill on enemy to reduce 1s Cooldown (0.5s interval)
Taking damage ≥ 30% Max HP within 3s will activate: Gains a Shield absorbs (400 + Lv*30) Damage (lasts 6s) Gains 20% Magic Life Steal (lasts 6s, Kill / Assist to extend by 3s)
Kill / Assist to restore 9% Max HP and 15% Max Mana

On using Movement / Charge Skill, gain 1 Shadow Blade stack (up to x3, lasts 4s) Next Normal Attack on enemy will consume all stacks, dealing an additional (30 + Lv*5 + 10% BonusAD) Physical Damage per stack
Next Normal Attack / Skill on enemy will deal an additional (50 + Lv*5 + (15% AP)) Magic Damage
Gains (10 - 38) Attack Damage Gains (15 - 57) Ability Power
Gains 12.5% Resistance

On striking an enemy with Normal Attack / Skill, gain 1 Desperate Duel stack (up to x10, lasts 3s) Each stack increases 2 Movement Speed At 10 stacks, restores 10% Lost HP, gains 15% Armor Pierce and Magic Pierce

Normal Attacks / Skills will mark the target for 1.5s. At 3 marks will activate: Explode (40 + Lv*4 + 25%BonusAD + 15%BonusAP) Magic Damage within 2.5m from the target 1s later, explode Magic Damage = Target's 6% Lost HP (+1% per 100 AD / 200 AP) within the same area
Activating Ultimate will immediately reduce Cooldown of Ultimate / Other Skills by 20% / 30% respectively
Gains 10 Movement Speed Gains 20 HP / 5s Gains 10 Mana / 5s
After entering bushes, enhances next Normal Attack up to 4s after leaving the bush, dealing an additional True Damage = Target's 4% Current HP
+ 15% Resistance + 10% Damage Reduction
Increases 10% Healing and Shield Effects (+10% for Targets with HP ≤ 50%)
Each nearby killed Minions or Wildlings grants a permanent Max HP buff (max 800) Minions: +8 Max HP each Small wildlings: +16 Max HP each Large wildlings: +24 Max HP each

On striking an enemy with a Crowd Control Skill (except Slow, Immobilize, Silence) will activate: Burns Magic Damage = 2% Max HP to nearby enemies every 0.5s for 3s Reduce burned enemies' (30 + Lv*3) Magic Armor
On taking damage from enemy each second, gain 1 stack for 3s. At 4 stacks will activate: Creates a 4m Shockwave, dealing Magic Damage = 2% Max HP Restores 5% Max HP (+ 2% / enemy hit)
Enhances next Normal Attack: Reduces enemy's 30% Movement Speed for 1s, and marks them with a Stealth Energy Charge After 3s, detonates the Energy Charge, deals Magic Damage = Target's 8% Max HP
Grants Impervious 4 minutes into the match Impervious: Activate: Supress yourself and become Untargetable for 1.5s, then gain a Shield absorbing (500 + Lv*40 + 50% AP) Damage for 1s
(Replace Restore with Enhanced Restore) Instantly restores around 660 HP and 210 Energy
Gains 15% Cooldown Reduction on Talents

Next Normal Attack / Skill will instantly kill a minion (not applicable to Siege Minion and Super Minion) After accumulating 10 minion kills using this enchantment, receive 200 Gold and reset the counter
Kill / Assist different enemy heroes to gain an additional stack (up to 5 additional stack) Each stack grants 8 Attack Damage and 12 Ability Power
Each 20s, gains 1 Alchemy stack (up to 3 stacks) Strike an Enemy / Tower to consume 1 stack and gain 16 Gold (max 800 Gold received)
Grants Resurrect to instantly respawn at the altar (can only cast twice) After 12 mins into the match, exchange unused Resurrect for 300 Gold each (this is not optional)
